g.text: Dynamic View: Android MCP bridge - Android bridge APK
[MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
3: Plan exact binding, arguments and backend scope
4: Check per-client grant, Ask consent, OS/backend authority and current epochs
5: Ask branch: notify pending local review when UI absent; original deadline unchanged
6: Ask branch: local exact review within original deadline; deny/timeout means no dispatch
7: Ask branch: approve exact local challenge or deny within original deadline
8: Approve exact challenge or return structured denial; continue only if approved
9: Pin compatible binding and coherent types
10: Recheck current document and contract pins
11: Fail-closed mandatory admission audit before dispatch
12: Return exact Admission and policy/contract pins
13: Dispatch Admission once; no replay of uncertain effects
14: beginDispatch: atomically recheck epochs/authority and register in-flight permit; reject if quiescing
15: Invoke permitted backend only under current dispatch permit
16: Release dispatch permit after bounded backend work or record unknown outcome
17: Record admitted dispatch and observed/unknown outcome; audit failure blocks further dispatch
18: Return bounded invocation result or structured denial/unknown outcome
19: Return single final JSON-RPC result/error; POST SSE normally terminates
